status: local candidate ready with advisories; unpublished

deferredFindings.title: Status filter also rejects an imperative with a participial object
deferredFindings.explanation: The new statusOnly expression rejects the valid next action “Review completed dry-run output.” because it matches “Review completed” without examining the following object. The added positive vector “Review the completed dry-run output.” does not cover this ambiguity. This affects advisory grading accuracy, not shipped runtime behavior.
deferredFindings.suggestedFix: In a subsequent grader refinement, distinguish completed-status phrases from completed modifying an object, and add this exact positive vector to both mirrored graders’ shared cases.

dimensions.simplification: The fix extends the existing small predicate; no new runtime abstraction or dependency.
dimensions.conventions: Current governing AGENTS.md, English tracked content, conventional commits and same-value version invariant are satisfied.
